description.en: Read the board, refine requirements, split them into tasks, move work forward and ask a human when a decision is needed.
description.zh-CN: 读取看板，细化需求并拆分任务，推进进度，需要人拍板时发起人工介入请求。

text.en: First call skill_read(name=devboard-playbook). Read the board, refine the newest RAW requirement and split it into development, testing and security-check tasks; raise a human-intervention request wherever a person must decide.
text.zh-CN: 先调用 skill_read(name=devboard-playbook)。看一下看板，把最新的原始需求细化并拆成研发、测试、安全校验任务，需要人拍板的地方发起介入请求。

prompt.en: First call skill_read(name=devboard-playbook). Read the board, refine the newest RAW requirement and split it into development, testing and security-check tasks; raise a human-intervention request wherever a person must decide.
prompt.zh-CN: 先调用 skill_read(name=devboard-playbook)。看一下看板，把最新的原始需求细化并拆成研发、测试、安全校验任务，需要人拍板的地方发起介入请求。

prompt.en: First call skill_read(name=devboard-playbook). Read the board, list overdue and open human-intervention requests, and continue the work whose requests have been resolved.
prompt.zh-CN: 先调用 skill_read(name=devboard-playbook)。读取看板，列出超时和待处理的人工介入请求；对已处理完成的请求，按处理结论继续推进相关工作。

prompt.en: Read the board and summarize progress: requirement states, blocked or failed tasks, and decisions waiting for people. Do not change anything.
prompt.zh-CN: 读取看板并汇总研发进度：各需求状态、阻塞或失败的任务、等待人决策的事项。只汇总，不做任何修改。

scenarios.en: New requirement → refine → split into tasks
scenarios.zh-CN: 新需求 → 细化 → 拆解为研发、测试、安全任务

scenarios.en: Decision point → human intervention → agent continues
scenarios.zh-CN: 决策点 → 人工介入处理 → 智能体继续推进

scenarios.en: Board overview → blocked work → next steps
scenarios.zh-CN: 研发全局进度 → 阻塞与失败任务 → 下一步

metadata.summary: A proof-of-concept task board for multi-agent software delivery: requirements, tasks and human-intervention requests on fictional data.
metadata.description: Proof-of-concept board with three state machines, an R&D coordinator agent and synthetic demo data.

zh-CN.summary: 研发多智能体协作任务看板概念演示：需求、任务与人工介入请求，数据均为虚构。
zh-CN.description: 含三套状态机、研发协调员智能体与虚构演示数据的概念验证看板。
